name_input: FABLAS IMPEX PRIVATE LIMITED; FABLAS IMPEX PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: No export record found. ImportKey page for this company shows only inbound lanes: "2026-02-04 | MAPA SPONTEX IBERICA S.A.U.. | FABLAS IMPEX PRIVATE LIMITED | CELLULOSE SHEET ROLL AM-21 0H ORANGE 31 121 M LINEALS (53 ROL) | Barcelona, SPAIN | CMA CGM LOGISTICS PARK ICD INCPL6, India | 39211400 | 7302449". Origin is always Spain, destination always an Indian ICD; the company appears exclusively in the Buyer column. Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 269 Records detected" and "Trading Partners 2 Known counterparties"; rows actually rendered on the free view = 5 shipment rows (2026-02-04, 2026-02-02, 2026-01-03, 2025-12-13, 2025-11-29), all imports. Supplier table shows 5 aggregated supplier rows (79 / 76 / 219 / 14 / 73 shipments) all pointing to MAPA SPONTEX IBERICA S.A.U. (Barcelona) as seller. Ports table: Barcelona 76, CMA CGM LOGISTICS PARK ICD 45, CMA CGM LOGISTICS PARK ICD INCPL6 36, BARCELONA 5 — all import-side lanes. No bill of lading with India as origin/destination abroad was seen.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403; eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403; volza.com returned HTTP 403; DuckDuckGo search backend was down ("searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>") for all queries, so no domestic-supply source could be located. Registered address on ImportKey is "70, NAJAFGARH ROAD, MOTI NAGAR" (Delhi address, not the claimed Uttar Pradesh state) — this is an address string only, not supply evidence.
note: Actual shipments verified: the company is a real, active importer of cellulose sheet rolls (MAPA SPONTEX, Spain) with 269 customs records, latest 2026-02-04 — but every visible record is an IMPORT into India. No export shipment, no export bill of lading, no outbound lane was found; export_status = none_found. The declared HS codes 392490 and 630710 do not match the observed import HS 39211400 (cellulose wadding/webs of cellulose fibres) — per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the database and the factual code should be recorded as 39211400 (import side). Domestic supply: следов поставок не найдено — no GST turnover, tender or contract evidence was retrievable because all four candidate sources were blocked (403) and the search backend was offline; this is a data-access gap, not proof of absence, hence domestic_status = unknown rather than none_found. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in the free views, not estimated. Role classification: trader/importer (buys finished goods from a single Spanish manufacturer and resells into India); no manufacturing evidence seen. PAN AAACF8092L and the Uttar Pradesh state claim were not independently verified — no registry source was reachable, so they remain unconfirmed.
